name: network-capture-inspector
description: Chrome MV3 extension for local HTTP, SSE, and WebSocket application-data capture

scripts.build: wxt build --filter-entrypoint background --filter-entrypoint content --filter-entrypoint injected --filter-entrypoint sidepanel
scripts.clean: wxt clean && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.output', { recursive: true, force: true })"
